title: Analysis: Is oral care’s category glow-up working?
summary: Oral care is following in the footsteps of skin care, with ingredients, design and sensorial experience now elevating the category. But the glow-up is aiming to transform from a buzzy moment into a sustainable evolution, as consumers seek health-related efficacy and trusted performance over novelty newness

title: Mona Kattan's Kayali eyes China top three fragrance spot in exclusive Sephora launch
summary: Fragrance brand Kayali, founded by Mona Kattan, made its exclusive omnichannel debut in China on 15 October across more than 300 stores and Sephora’s digital platforms, aiming to become one of Sephora China’s top three fragrance brands

title: Patrick Ta Beauty shakes up leadership team with CMO and Creative VP appointments
summary: The cosmetics brand, founded by make-up artist Patrick Ta, said the new appointments of Angela Simpson as Chief Marketing Officer and Carolyne Rapp as VP of Creative build on its current momentum and positioning

title: L’Oréal CEO Nicolas Hieronimus on GLP-1’s ‘impact’ on skin care sales
summary: Nicolas Hieronimus, CEO of French beauty giant L’Oréal, says the rise in GLP-1 weight loss drugs is ‘a very important phenomenon’ for the cosmetics industry, affecting skin care consumption, following the company’s Q3 2026 results

title: All eyes on Paris as registration opens for Paris Packaging Week’s biggest edition yet
summary: Paris Packaging Week will see 950 exhibitors put packaging innovation centre stage in Paris on 3 & 4 February 2027, with more than 80 conference sessions offering fresh perspectives on the industry’s future

title: Pantene reunites with ‘Ultimate Ambassador’ John Stamos after more than three decades
summary: Pantene has tapped actor John Stamos as its ‘Ultimate Ambassador’ 30-plus years after his original partnership with the Procter & Gamble-owned hair care brand, fronting a new video series in which he proves his famous hair is a product of the company

title: Ouai partners with You actor Victoria Pedretti on horror-inspired content series
summary: Ouai has teamed up with American actress Victoria Pedretti, who starred in Netflix thriller You, for a new content series tapping into the world of horror films as ‘The Chopper’ sweeps the hair care brand’s office

title: Aaron Terence Hughes’ ‘Hombre’ claims Pure Beauty Awards 2026: The fragrance win driving a new era of organic and natural materials
summary: The Readers’ Vote at the Pure Beauty Awards 2026 has crowned Aaron Terence Hughes’ Hombre Eau de Parfum as Best Fragrance. This consumer-driven victory serves as a definitive proof of concept for the brand's expanding high-performance cosmetic collection

title: The untold story of Garnier’s Micellar Cleansing Water
summary: The L’Oréal-owned legacy beauty brand lifts the lid on how its 13-year-old Micellar Cleansing Water became, and has remained, a category-defining multipurpose skin care item in Cosmetics Business’ ‘Untold Story’ series

title: Dermaself takes its AI skin analysis into remote clinical studies
summary: Dermaself's AI already turns a selfie into a personalised skincare routine on brand websites and in stores. The same measurement now lets testing laboratories run efficacy studies on up to 10,000 volunteers who photograph their skin at home. Here is what the technology does, and what brands should ask their lab for next
